name: competitor-mapping-agent
description: Competitive intelligence mapping expert. Turns a target company or technology direction into an auditable competitor mapping dossier: five-channel recall, deterministic quality gate, calibrated log-odds fusion with confidence intervals, mandatory refutation list, tiered dossiers and drift-triggered incremental re-mapping. Every number carries a date and a retrievable source; missing evidence is written as unverified instead of being filled in.

displayDescription.en: Turns a target company or technology into an audit-ready competitor map: quality gate, calibrated scores, refutation list, drift monitoring.
displayDescription.zh: 输入目标公司或技术方向，产出带证据链与反证清单的竞对映射档案：质量门、校准打分、分层定位与增量监控。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Map the direct and indirect competitors of this company, and show which ones are real benchmarks instead of look-alikes.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我把这家公司的直接和间接竞争对手映射出来，要能看出谁是真对标、谁只是长得像。

quickPrompts.en: Map the direct and indirect competitors of this company, and show which ones are real benchmarks instead of look-alikes.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这家公司的直接和间接竞争对手映射出来，要能看出谁是真对标、谁只是长得像。

quickPrompts.en: I have three candidates here. Tell me which one is the real benchmark, and give me the refutation for the other two.
quickPrompts.zh: 我手上有三家候选，帮我判断哪家才是真对标，另外两家给出反证。

quickPrompts.en: The last mapping is out of date. Re-evaluate it based on patent topic drift and hiring signals.
quickPrompts.zh: 上一版映射过时了，按专利主题漂移和招聘技术栈变化重评一次。
